translations.translatedText: # Sunday 23.1.2022 (radio)
The first regional elections were held in Finland. The National Coalition Party, SDP and the Centre Party got the most votes across the country. Many did not vote in the regional elections.
## Regional elections

![National Coalition Party chair Petteri Orpo (left) and SDP chair Sanna Marin.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4947,h_2782,x_12,y_145/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-90551761eda6f2574b5/1642965081)
Open image viewer
National Coalition Party chair Petteri Orpo and SDP chair Sanna Marin competed for the place of the biggest party in the regional elections. Photo: Silja Viitala / Yle
The regional elections have been held in Finland. In the elections, 21 regional councils were elected. They decide on social and health services.
The results of the regional elections show that the National Coalition Party got the most votes across the country. The National Coalition's support was over 21 per cent.
SDP and the Centre Party did almost as well as the National Coalition. Their support was over 19 per cent.
Other parties got clearly less support. The Finns Party got support of about 11 per cent, and other parties under 10 per cent.
These are the support figures when looking at the votes across the whole of Finland.
The regional elections were held for the first time in Finland now. Only a little under 50 per cent of the people who had the right to vote went to vote.
## Regional councils
![Centre Party chair Annika Saarikko.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5472,h_3078,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-90551661eda6f09a617/1669924100)
Open image viewer
Centre Party chair Annika Saarikko was pleased, because the Centre won the elections in 9 wellbeing services counties. Photo: Sakari Piippo / Yle
The regional councils were elected in the regional elections. The regional councils lead the wellbeing services counties. 21 wellbeing services counties will be set up in Finland.

The Centre Party won the regional elections in 9 wellbeing services counties. SDP and the National Coalition also became the biggest party in many wellbeing services counties. In 2 wellbeing services counties the biggest party is the RKP, that is, the Swedish People's Party.
So the regional councils decide on social and health services and on rescue services. Now the new regional councils will start considering what kinds of services Finns will get in the future.

The parties have different opinions, for example, on the role of private companies in social and health services. The regional councils must decide how large a role is given to private medical clinics, for example.
## Reform of social and health services
![Health centre sign.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4752,h_2671,x_0,y_245/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/17-69639583dc6029598f/1480928797)
Open image viewer
Photo: Yle, Tiina Jensen.
Finland's social and health services are being reformed so that people get good services across the whole country.
Until now, municipalities have run social and health services. However, Finland has over 300 municipalities, and many municipalities are so small that they cannot organise good services alone.

The idea is that large wellbeing services counties will be able to organise the services better. There is a lot to do, because the number of elderly people in Finland is growing and there is a shortage of carers.
Helsinki is an exception among the municipalities. It still provides the services itself. That is why regional elections were not held in Helsinki.
## The weather
![weather map](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12283031)
Open image viewer
On Monday the weather is mild. The temperature across the whole country is a little above zero.
On Tuesday the weather gets colder. The temperature is below zero across the whole country.
